description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman is hiring an Associate Software Engineer for its Space sector in the Pathways rotational program, which includes three engineering rotations. The role supports the Software and Controls group by assisting with software development, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
Associate Software Engineer supporting software development, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting under engineering team guidance

Responsibilities:
• Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining software programs or applications as guided by the engineering team
• Help troubleshoot and fix issues in software to improve performance and reliability
• Work with team members to understand project requirements and translate them into basic software solutions
• Follow instructions to perform software testing, document results, and provide feedback to the team
• Make simple updates or adjustments to software based on team feedback or identified issues
• Learn and apply industry best practices for writing, testing, and maintaining code
• Focus on software-related tasks only, excluding responsibilities related to hardware production or quality assurance

Requirements:
• Be completing or has completed their degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) from an accredited institution
• Be majoring in or having majored in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or other STEM related majors
• Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
• The ability to obtain Special Access Program within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs

Preferred:
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher
